issues.claim: Biondo Contracting - Roofing Specialists, website https://biondoroofing.com/
issues.problem: The listed domain no longer serves the roofer's site. Opening it returns a Thai-language online-slot/gambling page titled 'สล็อตโรม่าทดลอง - Apps on Google Play' (re-fetched raw to confirm). The business itself appears real (BBB Monroe profile, 38 Spotswood Ave), but the recorded website is wrong.
issues.fix: Clear the website field for Biondo, or replace it with a domain verified by opening it; do not use biondoroofing.com for outreach.

issues.claim: JANCO Electric, 81 Pension Rd Ste 111, Monroe Township, (732) 786-1800
issues.problem: Wrong town. jancoelectric.com titles the business 'Electrician | Manalapan Township, NJ' and its copy is aimed at Manalapan Twp and Freehold Twp; the BBB profile surfaced by search sits under Manalapan, and Pension Road is a Manalapan (07726) address. The phone number does match.
issues.fix: Remove from the Monroe zone, or re-town it to Manalapan Township and re-test the 10-mile radius.

issues.claim: Diamond Electrical Services, town 'Monroe Township', address 'Unknown'
issues.problem: Town is an unsupported inference - the mapper's own note says the street address was never seen. The company's site is aimed at North/East Brunswick and it serves Middlesex/Monmouth/Somerset; BuildZoom surfaces 34 Hardenburg Lane, East Brunswick as its address. Nothing shows a Monroe Township base.
issues.fix: Drop the entry, or re-classify it as an East Brunswick business outside this zone unless a Monroe address is confirmed.

issues.claim: Martin & Sons Roofing, 365 County Rd 613, Monroe Township
issues.problem: The cited page (martinsonsleakdetection.com/monroe-township-nj/) is a service-area landing page ('Our Roofing Services for Monroe Township') with no address; the 551 area-code phone and the domain point to a lead-generation/out-of-area operator rather than a Monroe-located shop. Address and in-zone presence are unverified.
issues.fix: Verify a physical Monroe Township address and NJ contractor registration before keeping it; otherwise remove.

issues.claim: Coverage gaps in roofing, electrical, auto repair and landscaping
issues.problem: Six clearly Monroe-based, eligible trade businesses that my own searches surfaced are absent from the list: Scotchwood Construction (roofing/siding/windows, Monroe-based per own site), Intelliscape Landscaping (314 Dey Grove Rd), Garden State Landscaping & Tree Service (145 Union Valley Rd), Edison Electric LLC (181 Dey Grove Rd), GD Auto Repair Services (1600 Perrineville Rd), CBA Autoworks (31 Gravel Hill-Spotswood Rd). Combined with the wrongly excluded Jerry Noonan's, only 15 of 22 eligible businesses my searches found are listed (about 68%), under the 70% bar.
issues.fix: Add these entries with their own site/directory sources, and re-check each category for a full top-of-category pass.

issues.claim: Jerry Noonan's Auto Center, 251 Applegarth Rd, Monroe Township, dropped as 'beyond 10 miles'
issues.problem: The distance screen looks inconsistently applied. Jerry Noonan's (Applegarth Rd) is roughly 8 miles from Milltown on a straight-line estimate (inference from its Monroe address), yet SMC Fence (121 Old Forge Rd), Comfort Oil (228 Dey Grove Rd) and Family Overhead Doors (207 Dey Grove Rd) are kept even though the mapper records them at 10.8-11.5 miles, i.e. outside the stated 10-mile zone.
issues.fix: Recompute distances from one fixed Milltown centre point for every entry; then either restore Jerry Noonan's or drop SMC Fence, Comfort Oil and Family Overhead Doors.

issues.claim: Roughly two-thirds of the list rests on a single Cylex listing
issues.problem: About 70 entries carry 'one directory only (Cylex)' and the mapper itself flags them as unconfirmed. Cylex now returns HTTP 403 to direct fetching, so those entries could not be independently opened in this check; existence and address for most of them is unproven, not merely unproven-active.
issues.fix: Treat single-source Cylex entries as unverified until each is matched to a second source (own website, BBB, state registration, or a phone-verified listing).

issues.claim: Suspected lead-generation clusters: AABC Locks, JMC Lock & Security, K Locksmith (all 609-619-02xx/03xx); Apex Appliance Repair and American Chimney Cleaning sharing (732) 257-4590; Muffler Auto Center and Royal Transmissions sharing address and phone
issues.problem: These look like one operator, a call-centre or a lead-gen network rather than separate local businesses. The mapper flags them but still keeps them as individual prospects, which inflates the list and risks wasted outreach.
issues.fix: Hold these entries out of the prospect list until each is matched to a distinct, verifiable business (e.g. an NJ trade-name/registration search).

issues.claim: Address data errors on retained entries
issues.problem: Alpha Termite & Pest Control is recorded at 164 Old Forge Rd, while a local listing returned by search places it at 9 Regent Dr, Monroe Township (phone matches). RKD Tree Service is recorded with address 'Unknown' although its Yellow Pages listing shows 433 Schoolhouse Rd. Summit Landscape & Lawn Services and Supreme Outdoor Maintenance have websites that publish no Monroe address at all, so their zone fit is unconfirmed.
issues.fix: Re-pull these addresses from a second source; fill or clear the missing values rather than leaving 'Unknown'.

issues.problem: No food, delivery-app, government, school, hospital, worship or bank entries were found, and no franchise brands (e.g. Mr. Electric of Monroe, Roto-Rooter) are included - those were correctly left out. The one residual risk is Hunt Construction Group at 1095 Cranbury South River Rd, a name used by a large national construction manager; the mapper already flags it as possibly a branch (inference from the name match).
issues.fix: Confirm Hunt Construction Group's local ownership/size before including it in outreach; no other exclusions needed.
